items.title: Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine to Star in B.J. Novak and A24's Las Vegas Drama 'American Epic'
items.summary:
Summary 

Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine are teaming up to star in a new drama series package titled American EpicThe project is being written by B.J. Novak and comes from Joe Hipps’ A24-based company Cut ToThe highly anticipated series is currently generating interest from multiple buyers including HBO and Amazon

A24 is officially shopping a highly anticipated new drama series package titled American Epic , starring Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine . Written by The Office alumnus B.J. Novak , the project hails from Joe Hipps’ A24-based production company Cut To and marks the first on-screen pairing for the two acclaimed actors.

Set against the backdrop of Las Vegas, American Epic centers on a high-stakes ideological clash. In a final bid to forge his lasting legacy, magnetic casino mogul Wyatt Pascal (played by Cage) squares off with Midwestern pastor Bill Massey (played by Pine). Together, the two opposing forces attempt to pull off one last impossible act: building something eternal in the most temporary place on earth.

The project has already generated significant interest across the industry, with platforms like HBO and Amazon currently eyeing the series as a potential acquisition. Novak serves as an executive producer alongside Pine, Ian Gotler of Barry Linen Motion Pictures, Hipps, and Patrick McDonald of Cut To. The package serves as another major talent-driven endeavor for Hipps, who previously secured straight-to-series orders for A24 television projects featuring Gwyneth Paltrow, Nicole Kidman, and Joel Edgerton.

American Epic arrives during a busy creative season…
items.t: Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine to Star in B.J. Novak and A24's Las Vegas Drama 'American Epic'

Drake has reportedly set a monumental new streaming benchmark on Spotify , reaching 18.9 billion streams across all credits in 2026. Setting a new single-year rap record before the calendar has even closed, the Toronto heavyweight has officially surpassed his previous high of 18.4 billion streams established in 2025, effectively claiming the top five streaming years in the genre's history.

The unprecedented surge in numbers began in May when Drake simultaneously released three highly anticipated solo albums— ICEMAN , MAID OF HONOUR , and HABIBTI . Arriving as his first solo efforts since his high-profile 2024 feud with Kendrick Lamar, the trio made Billboard 200 history by instantly claiming the top three spots on the chart. Propelled by massive early momentum, ICEMAN notably became the first hip-hop project of 2026 to surpass two billion Spotify plays, achieving the milestone in under three months.

A second wave of commercial dominance arrived in the autumn months with the release of FOMO , the deluxe edition of HABIBTI . You might not recognize the name Brembo , but chances are you've seen its work. The Seamless Cap, Gilet, and Crossbody Backpack round out the collection with a focus on technical utility.

items.title: Getting Down & Dirty with Li Hei Di
items.summary:
Li Hei Di was Pace ’s youngest artist when they joined the mega-gallery in 2024. In just a few years, their atmospheric dreamscapes propelled them into the ranks of contemporary art’s most promising new painters. “There’s me, and there’s sugar-coated me,” Li tells me from beneath one of several majestic canvases in their ongoing New York solo. Judging by the cloudy menageries of severed limbs overhead, in the year of mud , the London-based artist is ready to scrape off the sweet stuff.

“It feels like I’m stumbling through mud, but also a part of it — I can reshape myself,” they express. “It’s all about turning a muddy situation into a beautiful one.”

The Shenyang-born, London-based artist is just getting started. After completing their painting MA from the Royal College of Art, Li has shown work at Linseed Projects, Michael Kohn Gallery, and Pippy Houldsworth Gallery, with now three presentations with Pace under their belt. Spanning deep blues and purples to blushing sunset hues, their works pull from an eclectic mix of inspirations. Because sincerity, be it in bell hooks or survival reality TV, books wrought with grief or Hoppers , as Li points, has no one medium. They see painting as a raw, expressive “language” to get at truths and tragedies of life, sex, desire, and emotion, unearthing them from the ten-dollar art jargon they’re so often buried beneath.

On and off the canvas, Li’s on a transformational run. You’d think a career full-send this early on would set the tensions high, but for Li, painting is still the escape. During their last solo exhibition, land marks…
items.t: Getting Down & Dirty with Li Hei Di

items.title: BEYOND THE STREETS Brings Over 100 Artists to London's Saatchi Gallery
items.summary:
Summary 

Over 100 international artists, including FUTURA 2000, KAWS and Shepard Fairey, come together for a major exhibition at London's Saatchi Gallery.Curated by Roger Gastman, the show traces six decades of graffiti, hip-hop, fashion and activism through rare archives, historic works and immersive installations.

BEYOND THE STREETS has returned to London's Saatchi Gallery with an expansive new exhibition celebrating six decades of street culture and its lasting influence on contemporary art. Bringing together more than 100 international artists and cultural figures, the presentation explores how graffiti, hip-hop, fashion, music and activism have shaped creative expression across generations.

Spanning more than ten rooms, the exhibition features a mix of historic works, new commissions, rare archival materials and immersive installations. Among the participating artists are graffiti pioneers FUTURA 2000, LADY PINK, TAKI 183, DONDI and PHASE 2, alongside contemporary figures including KAWS, Shepard Fairey, Barry McGee, Kenny Scharf, Damien Hirst, Jenny Holzer, Invader and VHILS.

Rather than focusing solely on street art's visual language, BEYOND THE STREETS examines the broader cultural movements that emerged alongside it. Highlights include "Subway Art," "Tube Graffiti History," "Londonz Burning Archive" and "History of Spray Paint & Infinity Room," tracing the evolution of graffiti from New York City's subway system to London's underground scene. Dedicated sections also spotlight the influence of 2Tone music and fashion, hip-hop photography, underground…

items.title: Zain Memon Designs a Jaeger-LeCoultre Escape Game Set Inside the Manufacture
items.summary:
When Jaeger-LeCoultre first teased the idea of making a video game, the response from journalists was blunt. "I got feedback like, 'You're crazy! How do you want to develop a video game?'" recalls Chief Marketing Officer Matthieu Le Voyer. How, critics asked, could a watch Maison hope to compete with Blizzard and Activision? But the Vallée de Joux Manufacture was never trying to build the next Call of Duty. Instead, the latest chapter of its Made of Makers™ program brings video games, often called the "10th Art," into a cross-disciplinary roster that already counts sound artist Zimoun, musician TØKIO M¥ERS, street light-painter Roy Wang and pastry chef Nina Métayer.

This time, the Maker in the spotlight is Zain Memon , a Mumbai-born, Goa-based storyteller widely regarded as India's most influential game designer. The self-taught creative is best known for SHASN , a political strategy board game that won the Social Impact Award at IndieCade Europe, and its sequel SHASN: AZADI . He’s now deep into MAYA , a sprawling transmedia universe spanning novels, graphic novels, board games and film. For Le Voyer, the board-game pedigree was the point. Unlike mobile games built on quick dopamine hits, board games ask players to sit with a system for hours, making Memon a more natural fit than any digital agency.

The result is The Valley of Inventions , an escape game set inside the Manufacture-Atelier at the Maison's origins, with the player stepping into the role of Élie LeCoultre as he inherits the secrets of the trade. Progress hinges on understanding how watchmaking works: iconic…
items.t: Zain Memon Designs a Jaeger-LeCoultre Escape Game Set Inside the Manufacture

items.title: REO Trucks Unveils the Antithesis of the Modern Truck
items.summary:
Summary 

REO unveils the Runabout truck and SUV lineup.Its utilitarian design prioritizes physical controls, simplicity, and easy repairs.Texas-built models start at $21,500 USD, with deliveries expected by late 2028.

The historic American marque REO is officially back, teaming up with Frank Stephenson 's eponymous design studio to debut the all-new Runabout range. Powered by petrol, the range consists of the T4X work truck, the T4C crew cab and the S4C family SUV. The lineup is a significant departure away from the bloated, tech-heavy trucks currently dominating the market. Instead, REO is doubling down on a radically simple, right-to-repair ethos, delivering a trio of vehicles engineered to be affordable, easily maintained, and last decades.

Visually, the Runabout range grounds itself in its utilitarian aesthetic while still carving out a distinct identity. The upright front grille draws direct inspiration from America’s oldest pick-up, the 1915 REO Speed Wagon, while its broad shoulders and forward-leaning stance are modeled after the American bison. Simplicity and repairability are at the heart of the design. Frankstephenson design opted for standard-size, stacked LED headlights and bolt-on wheel arch extensions that owners can easily source and replace off the shelf if damaged. Inside the cabin, physical controls have been intentionally retained and sized for everyday use, even with thick work gloves on.

All three models sit on a shared ladder-frame chassis, utilizing the same wheelbase and front bodywork before diverging into different purpose-built forms. The…
items.t: REO Trucks Unveils the Antithesis of the Modern Truck

items.title: Nike and Devin Booker Officially Unveil the Book 3 Alongside a fragment design Collaboration
items.summary:

Nike and Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker have officially introduced the Nike Book 3 basketball sneakerThe new silhouette pairs a predominantly mesh upper with a forefoot Zoom Strobel and Cushlon 3.0 midsoleThe Book 3 and its accompanying apparel collection are set to release globally in Spring 2027

Nike and Devin Booker have officially introduced the Nike Book 3 , marking the next evolution in the athlete's signature basketball franchise. Unveiled as part of the brand's World of Athletes showcase, the new silhouette continues to operate at the intersection of responsive on-court performance and timeless, everyday style. 

Created for players who prioritize freedom of movement and a low-to-the-ground court feel, the Nike Book 3 perfectly balances an athlete-curated performance system with the classic, wearable design language that defines the Book line. Diving into the technical specifications, the Book 3 is constructed with a predominantly mesh upper for lightweight breathability. Underfoot, the sneaker is engineered with a forefoot Zoom Strobel unit and a Cushlon 3.0 midsole to deliver a highly responsive and flexible ride. items.title: 007's New Watch Dilemma: Will Robert Pattinson Bring Jaeger-LeCoultre to MI6?
items.summary:
The announcement that Robert Pattinson will officially step into the tuxedo as the next James Bond didn’t just shake up the film industry—it set off a high-stakes turf war in the luxury watch world. For 31 years, Omega has enjoyed an ironclad, incredibly lucrative grip on the 007 franchise. Since GoldenEye in 1995, every cinematic iteration of the British spy has checked his Omega Seamaster before saving the world.

But Pattinson’s arrival introduces a massive complication: just months before being unveiled as the new Bond, he was named a global brand ambassador for Jaeger-LeCoultre (JLC).

The Commercial Tug-of-War When Pattinson appeared in his official Bond announcement photos, watch enthusiasts immediately noticed the glaring detail: his wrist was bare. This conspicuous absence is fueling rampant speculation about a behind-the-scenes battle between two Swiss giants.

Historically, the actor playing Bond naturally absorbs the Omega partnership—both Pierce Brosnan and Daniel Craig became direct Omega ambassadors during their respective tenures. But Pattinson enters the franchise with an active, high-profile contract with a rival, Richemont-owned brand.

While Jaeger-LeCoultre will undoubtedly push hard to break Omega’s three-decade exclusivity streak and finally put a JLC on 007's wrist, Omega (backed by the massive marketing budget of the Swatch Group) is unlikely to surrender its most iconic cultural pillar without a fierce financial fight. The ultimate compromise might see Pattinson retaining his JLC ties off-screen while dutifully wearing Omega on-camera—but if the…

items.title: Soho House Puts 11,000 Artworks Between Cloth Covers in ‘Soho Art House’
items.summary:
Summary 

'Soho Art House' is the first book dedicated to the art collection that hangs across roughly 50 Soho House locations in 19 countriesChief Art Director Kate Bryan wrote and edited the cloth-bound volume, which combines essays, conversations and photographyTwelve cultural figures, including Klaus Biesenbach and Helen Fielding, each pick a favorite work from their local House

Soho House has released Soho Art House , a cloth-bound book that opens up its global art collection, which spans more than 11,000 works, for the first time. Kate Bryan, the club’s Chief Art Director, wrote and edited the volume after spending the past decade curating and caring for the collection, and she organized it as a guided tour through the Houses rather than a straight catalog.

The book is built in clear layers. Andrew Carnie writes the foreword, and Bryan’s own writing appears alongside essays from Ferren Gipson, Jennifer Higgie, Suzanne Hudson and Alastair Sooke. Photography of the works in place throughout the clubs runs between the texts, showing how the art lives in bars, bedrooms and hallways instead of on gallery walls.

The most personal section hands the selection over to outsiders. Twelve cultural figures each choose a favorite piece from their local House and explain why it matters to them. Neue Nationalgalerie director Klaus Biesenbach takes on Damien Hirst, and novelist Helen Fielding writes about Harland Miller. The book also includes a roundtable moderated by Bryan with Soho House founder Nick Jones, Jonathan Yeo, who first came up with the collection, and writer and…

I haven’t always worn boots. For years I wrote them off – at 5ft 8in, I was convinced anything above the ankle would make my legs look shorter. Then I started wearing them with the right trousers – a straight leg that falls over the top – and realised I’d spent a decade getting winter wrong. All anyone sees is a smart pair of shoes that happens to keep your ankles warm.

Here’s the thing: boots needn’t be intimidating. They’re just the wintry version of the leather shoes you already own. A chelsea is your loafer – it goes with pretty much everything in your wardrobe and every event in your diary, Christmas parties included. A derby boot is laced up, a bit sturdier and just as happy with jeans. The chukka is your weekend trainer. And the chunky, rubber-soled ones? Just think of them as an umbrella for your feet.
